verdict.rationale: The evidence documents on-demand jobs built from chained tasks (import, convert, export), but nothing shows CloudConvert itself offering a recurring schedule or cron-like trigger. Zapier automation is a third-party integration, a user-side workaround that earns no credit, and auto-refill of credits is a billing feature, not job scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
